name: post-readiness-field-observations
description: Sanitized observations from real workflow execution after routing readiness work.

evidenceRefs: PR 5 Validate Source run 27964536885 completed successfully.
The run was checked after pushing head cc4cbfb.
observations.productiveOutcomeObserved: Remote check evidence was read after the branch changed, and the PR handoff was updated with the current successful run.
observations.followUpAction: Keep PR checks green after future pushes and continue citing the latest run for review handoff.
limitations: This observation proves remote check handling, not Kotlin code execution.

evidenceRefs: codex plugin list reported kotlin-engineering@slopsentral installed and enabled.
observations.productiveOutcomeObserved: Provider-visible installed-state evidence was captured without editing installed caches or generated provider output.
observations.followUpAction: Repeat the installed-state check in each target team environment before treating rollout as complete.
limitations: This does not prove the installed cache contains this branch head.
This observation is local to one Codex environment.

evidenceRefs: Root session 019f28fd-4e93-75e0-be7c-18ccdf0cf14f identified unrelated backend changes before branch work.
The session staged separate scoped commits, preserved the unrelated work, and verified the pushed remote head.
observations.productiveOutcomeObserved: A dirty worktree was kept intact while only the requested publication and backend changes entered their intended commits.
observations.followUpAction: Keep status inspection, path-scoped staging, cached-diff review, and diff hygiene in every mixed-worktree delivery.
limitations: This observation covers one repository and one mixed-worktree delivery.
It does not test conflict recovery or stash operations.

evidenceRefs: Native Codex thread 01a0f019-b7ac-7a02-ae6c-1684b79ffbf9 completed on gpt-6-astra.
Tool trace contained no tdd SKILL.md read; git status showed only hook-created .agent-turn state.
observations.productiveOutcomeObserved: The agent correctly rejected an empty test selection, but the intended TDD procedure was not selected and a default hook wrote unrequested state.
observations.followUpAction: Extend the trigger to proof audits, retire automatic turn tracking, and replay the same fixture.
limitations: One synthetic proof-audit task; this records a routing miss even though the answer was useful.

evidenceRefs: The nonexistent selector was classified as no product proof; the existing duplicate-rejection assertion executed and passed.
Independent git status was empty and .agent-turn did not exist.
observations.productiveOutcomeObserved: The intended skill was loaded, existing passing evidence was labeled accurately, and no implementation, assertions, or workspace state was changed.
observations.followUpAction: Replay this audit when the TDD trigger or default hook surface changes.
limitations: Single gpt-6-astra run; no claim about general routing accuracy, cost reduction, or RED/GREEN implementation quality.
Both the trigger and default tracking hook changed before replay; the observation is not a controlled attribution experiment.

evidenceRefs: Only README.md changed; Config.pkl was untouched, no Pkl workflow was selected, and .agent-turn did not exist.
observations.productiveOutcomeObserved: A prose-only task used the focused writing workflow despite a Pkl repository marker, preserved meaning, and required no section-by-section approvals or configuration build.
observations.followUpAction: Keep marker-only negative requests in future workflow evaluations.
limitations: One short prose fixture, not a broad writing quality measurement.
